info.name: White anime blossom three
info.description: This wallpaper is a beautifully composed piece that captures a tranquil and almost nostalgic atmosphere. A young girl stands beneath a majestic white sakura tree, its delicate blossoms gently drifting through the air. She holds a guitar case, suggesting she is either arriving or departing from a quiet moment of music. The surrounding scenery, including traditional-style buildings and distant mountains, is rendered in a monochrome palette, with the soft pink and white hues of the cherry blossoms standing out, creating a striking contrast. The scene feels peaceful yet contemplative, as if the girl is pausing to take in the fleeting beauty of the moment before continuing her journey.
